display.name: mongot pods up
display.description: mongot pods that Prometheus scrapes successfully.

display.name: Envoy pods up
display.description: Envoy pods that Prometheus scrapes successfully.

display.name: mongot pods in Envoy
display.description: The smallest number of healthy mongot pods any Envoy pod sees. Below the number of mongot pods, an Envoy pod has lost one.

display.name: Searches per second
display.description: Text and vector searches per second, all mongot pods, 5 minute rate.

display.name: Largest share on one pod
display.description: The share of all searches that the busiest mongot pod served. With three pods and even balancing this is about 33%. Near 100% means one pod serves everything while the others stay Ready: the failure that produces no error. 0% when no search ran in the last 5 minutes.

display.name: Searches per second, per mongot pod
display.description: Stacked: one band per mongot pod, and the top edge is all searches. Envoy picks a mongot pod per request, so the bands should be of equal height. 5 minute rate.

spec.query: (sum by (pod) ((rate(mongot_command_searchCommandTotalLatency_seconds_count{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"}[5m]) + rate(mongot_command_vectorSearchCommandTotalLatency_seconds_count{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"}[5m])))) unless on (pod) (label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-0", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-1", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-2", "", ""))

display.name: Share of searches, per mongot pod
display.description: Stacked: each pod's part of all searches over the last 5 minutes, adding up to 100%. Three pods sharing evenly are three bands of a third each.

spec.query: (sum by (pod) ((rate(mongot_command_searchCommandTotalLatency_seconds_count{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"}[5m]) + rate(mongot_command_vectorSearchCommandTotalLatency_seconds_count{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"}[5m]))) / scalar(sum((rate(mongot_command_searchCommandTotalLatency_seconds_count{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"}[5m]) + rate(mongot_command_vectorSearchCommandTotalLatency_seconds_count{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"}[5m]))))) unless on (pod) (label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-0", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-1", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-2", "", ""))

display.name: Share of searches now, by mongot pod
display.description: Each pod's part of the searches of the last 5 minutes. Three equal slices is even balancing; one slice taking the pie is the failure that produces no error. Empty when no search ran.

spec.query: (sum by (pod) (rate(mongot_command_searchCommandTotalLatency_seconds_count{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc",pod="__SEARCH__-search-0-0"}[5m] @ end()) + rate(mongot_command_vectorSearchCommandTotalLatency_seconds_count{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc",pod="__SEARCH__-search-0-0"}[5m] @ end())) or label_replace(vector(0), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-0", "", "")) and on () (sum(rate(mongot_command_searchCommandTotalLatency_seconds_count{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"}[5m] @ end()) + rate(mongot_command_vectorSearchCommandTotalLatency_seconds_count{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"}[5m] @ end())) > 0)

(sum by (pod) (rate(mongot_command_searchCommandTotalLatency_seconds_count{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc",pod="__SEARCH__-search-0-1"}[5m] @ end()) + rate(mongot_command_vectorSearchCommandTotalLatency_seconds_count{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc",pod="__SEARCH__-search-0-1"}[5m] @ end())) or label_replace(count(up{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc",pod!="__SEARCH__-search-0-0"} @ end() or sum by (pod) (rate(mongot_command_searchCommandTotalLatency_seconds_count{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc",pod!="__SEARCH__-search-0-0"}[5m] @ end()) + rate(mongot_command_vectorSearchCommandTotalLatency_seconds_count{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc",pod!="__SEARCH__-search-0-0"}[5m] @ end()))) * 0, "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-1", "", "")) and on () (sum(rate(mongot_command_searchCommandTotalLatency_seconds_count{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"}[5m] @ end()) + rate(mongot_command_vectorSearchCommandTotalLatency_seconds_count{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"}[5m] @ end())) > 0)

(sum by (pod) (rate(mongot_command_searchCommandTotalLatency_seconds_count{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc",pod="__SEARCH__-search-0-2"}[5m] @ end()) + rate(mongot_command_vectorSearchCommandTotalLatency_seconds_count{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc",pod="__SEARCH__-search-0-2"}[5m] @ end())) or label_replace(count(up{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc",pod!~"__SEARCH__-search-0-[01]"} @ end() or sum by (pod) (rate(mongot_command_searchCommandTotalLatency_seconds_count{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc",pod!~"__SEARCH__-search-0-[01]"}[5m] @ end()) + rate(mongot_command_vectorSearchCommandTotalLatency_seconds_count{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc",pod!~"__SEARCH__-search-0-[01]"}[5m] @ end()))) * 0, "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-2", "", "")) and on () (sum(rate(mongot_command_searchCommandTotalLatency_seconds_count{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"}[5m] @ end()) + rate(mongot_command_vectorSearchCommandTotalLatency_seconds_count{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"}[5m] @ end())) > 0)

label_replace(sum(sum by (pod) (rate(mongot_command_searchCommandTotalLatency_seconds_count{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc",pod!~"__SEARCH__-search-0-[0-2]"}[5m] @ end()) + rate(mongot_command_vectorSearchCommandTotalLatency_seconds_count{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc",pod!~"__SEARCH__-search-0-[0-2]"}[5m] @ end()))), "pod", "further pods", "", "") and on () (sum(rate(mongot_command_searchCommandTotalLatency_seconds_count{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"}[5m] @ end()) + rate(mongot_command_vectorSearchCommandTotalLatency_seconds_count{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"}[5m] @ end())) > 0)

display.name: Requests per second to mongot, per Envoy pod
display.description: 5 minute rate. One Envoy pod at zero is normal with one mongod connection: the Route places connections, not requests.

spec.query: (sum by (pod) (rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_total{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-envoy-stats",envoy_cluster_name="mongot_rs_cluster"}[5m]))) and on (pod) topk(1, max by (pod) (kube_pod_start_time{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",pod=~"__SEARCH__-search-lb-0-.*"}))

(sum by (pod) (rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_total{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-envoy-stats",envoy_cluster_name="mongot_rs_cluster"}[5m]))) and on (pod) (topk(2, max by (pod) (kube_pod_start_time{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",pod=~"__SEARCH__-search-lb-0-.*"})) unless topk(1, max by (pod) (kube_pod_start_time{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",pod=~"__SEARCH__-search-lb-0-.*"})))

(sum by (pod) (rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_total{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-envoy-stats",envoy_cluster_name="mongot_rs_cluster"}[5m]))) and on (pod) (topk(3, max by (pod) (kube_pod_start_time{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",pod=~"__SEARCH__-search-lb-0-.*"})) unless topk(2, max by (pod) (kube_pod_start_time{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",pod=~"__SEARCH__-search-lb-0-.*"})))

(sum by (pod) (rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_total{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-envoy-stats",envoy_cluster_name="mongot_rs_cluster"}[5m]))) unless on (pod) topk(3, max by (pod) (kube_pod_start_time{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",pod=~"__SEARCH__-search-lb-0-.*"}))

display.name: Open connections from mongod, per Envoy pod
display.description: Where the Route's balance algorithm put each connection.

spec.query: (sum by (pod) (envoy_listener_downstream_cx_active{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-envoy-stats",envoy_listener_address="0.0.0.0_27028"})) and on (pod) topk(1, max by (pod) (kube_pod_start_time{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",pod=~"__SEARCH__-search-lb-0-.*"}))

(sum by (pod) (envoy_listener_downstream_cx_active{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-envoy-stats",envoy_listener_address="0.0.0.0_27028"})) and on (pod) (topk(2, max by (pod) (kube_pod_start_time{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",pod=~"__SEARCH__-search-lb-0-.*"})) unless topk(1, max by (pod) (kube_pod_start_time{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",pod=~"__SEARCH__-search-lb-0-.*"})))

(sum by (pod) (envoy_listener_downstream_cx_active{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-envoy-stats",envoy_listener_address="0.0.0.0_27028"})) and on (pod) (topk(3, max by (pod) (kube_pod_start_time{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",pod=~"__SEARCH__-search-lb-0-.*"})) unless topk(2, max by (pod) (kube_pod_start_time{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",pod=~"__SEARCH__-search-lb-0-.*"})))

(sum by (pod) (envoy_listener_downstream_cx_active{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-envoy-stats",envoy_listener_address="0.0.0.0_27028"})) unless on (pod) topk(3, max by (pod) (kube_pod_start_time{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",pod=~"__SEARCH__-search-lb-0-.*"}))

display.name: Retries per second, per Envoy pod
display.description: Envoy retries onto another mongot pod when one sheds load or resets a stream. Sustained retries mean mongot is undersized. 5 minute rate.

spec.query: (sum by (pod) (rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_retry_total{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-envoy-stats",envoy_cluster_name="mongot_rs_cluster"}[5m]))) and on (pod) topk(1, max by (pod) (kube_pod_start_time{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",pod=~"__SEARCH__-search-lb-0-.*"}))

(sum by (pod) (rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_retry_total{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-envoy-stats",envoy_cluster_name="mongot_rs_cluster"}[5m]))) and on (pod) (topk(2, max by (pod) (kube_pod_start_time{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",pod=~"__SEARCH__-search-lb-0-.*"})) unless topk(1, max by (pod) (kube_pod_start_time{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",pod=~"__SEARCH__-search-lb-0-.*"})))

(sum by (pod) (rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_retry_total{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-envoy-stats",envoy_cluster_name="mongot_rs_cluster"}[5m]))) and on (pod) (topk(3, max by (pod) (kube_pod_start_time{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",pod=~"__SEARCH__-search-lb-0-.*"})) unless topk(2, max by (pod) (kube_pod_start_time{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",pod=~"__SEARCH__-search-lb-0-.*"})))

(sum by (pod) (rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_retry_total{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-envoy-stats",envoy_cluster_name="mongot_rs_cluster"}[5m]))) unless on (pod) topk(3, max by (pod) (kube_pod_start_time{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",pod=~"__SEARCH__-search-lb-0-.*"}))

display.name: Responses per second from mongot, by class
display.description: 2xx is success. gRPC errors still answer 200; see the search failures panel. 5 minute rate.

display.name: Envoy to mongot latency, 95th percentile
display.description: Time Envoy waited for mongot, across both Envoy pods, over the last 5 minutes.

display.name: Average search latency, per mongot pod
display.description: Text searches only, averaged over 5 minutes. An average hides the slowest searches: mongot exposes no latency buckets, only its own quantiles per pod (0.5 to 0.99), which this panel does not draw. No line while a pod serves none.

spec.query: (sum by (pod) (rate(mongot_command_searchCommandTotalLatency_seconds_sum{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"}[5m])) / sum by (pod) (rate(mongot_command_searchCommandTotalLatency_seconds_count{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"}[5m]))) and on (pod) label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-0", "", "")

(sum by (pod) (rate(mongot_command_searchCommandTotalLatency_seconds_sum{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"}[5m])) / sum by (pod) (rate(mongot_command_searchCommandTotalLatency_seconds_count{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"}[5m]))) and on (pod) label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-1", "", "")

(sum by (pod) (rate(mongot_command_searchCommandTotalLatency_seconds_sum{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"}[5m])) / sum by (pod) (rate(mongot_command_searchCommandTotalLatency_seconds_count{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"}[5m]))) and on (pod) label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-2", "", "")

(sum by (pod) (rate(mongot_command_searchCommandTotalLatency_seconds_sum{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"}[5m])) / sum by (pod) (rate(mongot_command_searchCommandTotalLatency_seconds_count{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"}[5m]))) unless on (pod) (label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-0", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-1", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-2", "", ""))

display.name: Search failures per second, per mongot pod
display.description: Text and vector searches that mongot failed, 5 minute rate.

spec.query: (sum by (pod) (rate(mongot_command_searchCommandFailure_total{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"}[5m]) + rate(mongot_command_vectorSearchCommandFailure_total{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"}[5m]))) unless on (pod) (label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-0", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-1", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-2", "", ""))

display.name: Replication lag, per mongot pod
display.description: How far the pod's most delayed index is behind the source replica set.

spec.query: (max by (pod) (mongot_index_stats_indexing_replicationLagMs{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"})) unless on (pod) (label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-0", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-1", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-2", "", ""))

display.name: JVM memory used, per mongot pod
display.description: Heap and non-heap together.

spec.query: (sum by (pod) (mongot_jvm_memory_used_bytes{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"})) unless on (pod) (label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-0", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-1", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-2", "", ""))

display.name: CPU used, per mongot pod
display.description: mongot's own CPU use, averaged over 5 minutes, as a share of the CPUs the process sees (mongot_system_cpu_count; with a CPU limit of 1 that is one core).

spec.query: (max by (pod) (avg_over_time(mongot_process_cpu_usage{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"}[5m]))) unless on (pod) (label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-0", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-1", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-2", "", ""))

display.name: JVM heap used, percent of limit, per mongot pod
display.description: Heap in use against the heap's maximum. The panel above shows heap and non-heap together, in bytes.

spec.query: (sum by (pod) (mongot_jvm_memory_used_bytes{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc",area="heap"}) / sum by (pod) (mongot_jvm_memory_max_bytes{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc",area="heap"})) and on (pod) label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-0", "", "")

(sum by (pod) (mongot_jvm_memory_used_bytes{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc",area="heap"}) / sum by (pod) (mongot_jvm_memory_max_bytes{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc",area="heap"})) and on (pod) label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-1", "", "")

(sum by (pod) (mongot_jvm_memory_used_bytes{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc",area="heap"}) / sum by (pod) (mongot_jvm_memory_max_bytes{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc",area="heap"})) and on (pod) label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-2", "", "")

(sum by (pod) (mongot_jvm_memory_used_bytes{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc",area="heap"}) / sum by (pod) (mongot_jvm_memory_max_bytes{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc",area="heap"})) unless on (pod) (label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-0", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-1", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-2", "", ""))

display.name: Time in garbage collection, per mongot pod
display.description: Share of time the JVM spent paused for garbage collection, 5 minute rate.

spec.query: (sum by (pod) (rate(mongot_jvm_gc_pause_seconds_sum{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"}[5m]))) unless on (pod) (label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-0", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-1", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-2", "", ""))

display.name: Uptime, per mongot pod
display.description: Time since the mongot process started. A fall to zero is a restart.

spec.query: (max by (pod) (mongot_process_uptime_seconds{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"})) unless on (pod) (label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-0", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-1", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-2", "", ""))

display.name: Search work run outside the parallel pool, per mongot pod
display.description: Tasks per second (5 minute rate) that found mongot's concurrent search or vector rescoring pool full and ran on the calling thread instead. The search is still answered; above zero, the pool is saturated.

spec.query: (sum by (pod) (rate(mongot_rejectedConcurrentSearchExecutionCount_total{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"}[5m]) + rate(mongot_rejectedConcurrentVectorRescoringExecutionCount_total{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"}[5m]))) unless on (pod) (label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-0", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-1", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-2", "", ""))

display.name: Each mongot pod, now
display.description: One row per mongot pod, its name on its colour in the charts. Every pod holds every index, so the first four columns should read the same on every row.

display.name: Index size, per mongot pod
display.description: Bytes of all search and vector indexes on the pod. Every pod holds every index, so the lines should sit close together; each pod merges its own segments, so they need not be equal.

spec.query: (sum by (pod) (mongot_index_stats_indexSizeBytes{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"})) unless on (pod) (label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-0", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-1", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-2", "", ""))

display.name: Documents indexed, per mongot pod
display.description: Documents in all indexes on the pod. Equal on every pod once each has caught up with mongod.

spec.query: (sum by (pod) (mongot_index_stats_numLuceneDocs{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"})) unless on (pod) (label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-0", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-1", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-2", "", ""))

display.name: Indexes not STEADY, per mongot pod
display.description: Indexes whose state is anything but STEADY: INITIAL_SYNC, STALE, FAILED, RECOVERING and the rest. Should be 0; above it, that pod's copy of an index is not ready.

display.name: Indexes in catalog, per mongot pod
display.description: How many indexes each pod knows about. The same on every pod.

spec.query: (sum by (pod) (mongot_configState_indexesInCatalog{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"})) unless on (pod) (label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-0", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-1", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-2", "", ""))

display.name: Data volume used, per mongot pod
display.description: Used share of the file system under mongot's data path, as mongot reports it. With a volume of its own per pod this is that volume; with a hostpath provisioner it is the node's disk, the same on every pod.

spec.query: (1 - (sum by (pod) (mongot_system_disk_space_data_path_free_bytes{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"}) / sum by (pod) (mongot_system_disk_space_data_path_total_bytes{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"}))) and on (pod) label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-0", "", "")

(1 - (sum by (pod) (mongot_system_disk_space_data_path_free_bytes{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"}) / sum by (pod) (mongot_system_disk_space_data_path_total_bytes{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"}))) and on (pod) label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-1", "", "")

(1 - (sum by (pod) (mongot_system_disk_space_data_path_free_bytes{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"}) / sum by (pod) (mongot_system_disk_space_data_path_total_bytes{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"}))) and on (pod) label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-2", "", "")

(1 - (sum by (pod) (mongot_system_disk_space_data_path_free_bytes{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"}) / sum by (pod) (mongot_system_disk_space_data_path_total_bytes{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"}))) unless on (pod) (label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-0", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-1", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-2", "", ""))

display.name: Indexing operations per second, per mongot pod
display.description: Inserts, updates and deletes applied to the indexes, 5 minute rate. Every pod applies the same changes, so the lines should move together.

spec.query: (sum by (pod) (rate(mongot_index_stats_indexing_insert_total{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"}[5m]) + rate(mongot_index_stats_indexing_update_total{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"}[5m]) + rate(mongot_index_stats_indexing_delete_total{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"}[5m]))) unless on (pod) (label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-0", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-1", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "pod", "__SEARCH__-search-0-2", "", ""))

display.name: Indexes
display.description: Search and vector indexes mongot holds, counted by index id over all pods.

display.name: Indexes being built
display.description: Indexes that some pod holds in the state INITIAL_SYNC or NOT_STARTED: being built or rebuilt, and not served from that pod yet. 0 when none is.

display.name: Indexes with no host listed
display.description: Indexes for which the source deployment lists no mongot host, from the index info exporter. Should be 0. Above 0 while searches work, the mongot pods have lost their heartbeat rows and $listSearchIndexes reports every index PENDING: restart the mongot pods one at a time. 0 also when the exporter is off.

display.name: Each index
display.description: One row per index. With the index info exporter on (monitoring.indexInfo) an index is named as the source deployment names it, database.collection / index; without it, by the id mongot's metrics carry. The id is the one in mongot's metrics and logs. Stored source is what the index's definition stores, known only with the exporter. Vector memory is what a vector index wants resident, 0 for a search index.

max by (index, indexId_logString) (label_join(label_join((max by (indexId_logString) (mongot_index_stats_requiredMemoryBytes{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"})) * on (indexId_logString) group_left (database, collection, index_name) max by (indexId_logString, database, collection, index_name) (mongodb_search_index_info{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-index-info"} @ end()), "ns", ".", "database", "collection"), "index", " / ", "ns", "index_name") or on (indexId_logString) label_replace(max by (indexId_logString) (mongot_index_stats_requiredMemoryBytes{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"}), "index", "$1", "indexId_logString", "(.*)"))

display.name: Each index, now
display.description: One row per index. With the index info exporter on (monitoring.indexInfo) an index is named as the source deployment names it, database.collection / index; without it, by the id mongot's metrics carry. Size and documents are the largest reading over the pods. The size is everything in the index's directory, stored source and vectors included. Lucene docs are the documents as the index holds them: the collection's documents, and one more for every embedded document of an embeddedDocuments field; bytes per doc is the size over that count. Growth is the size now less the size 24 hours ago, or the whole size of an index younger than that.

max by (index) (label_join(label_join((max by (indexId_logString) (mongot_index_stats_indexSizeBytes{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"}) / (max by (indexId_logString) (mongot_index_stats_numLuceneDocs{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"}) > 0)) * on (indexId_logString) group_left (database, collection, index_name) max by (indexId_logString, database, collection, index_name) (mongodb_search_index_info{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-index-info"} @ end()), "ns", ".", "database", "collection"), "index", " / ", "ns", "index_name") or on (indexId_logString) label_replace(max by (indexId_logString) (mongot_index_stats_indexSizeBytes{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"}) / (max by (indexId_logString) (mongot_index_stats_numLuceneDocs{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"}) > 0), "index", "$1", "indexId_logString", "(.*)"))

display.name: Each index, in the last hour
display.description: One row per index. With the index info exporter on (monitoring.indexInfo) an index is named as the source deployment names it, database.collection / index; without it, by the id mongot's metrics carry. Counted over the last hour, all pods. A search is one query the index ran, a search or a vector search; a query mongot refused as invalid is not counted. The batch time is the average time to produce one batch of results (mongot gives a sum and a count, and no buckets for a percentile), for search indexes that were searched; empty otherwise. Sync errors are the exceptions mongot met while it built or followed the index. The lag is the largest over the pods, now, in whole seconds, and is empty while the index is built.

max by (index) (label_join(label_join((sum by (indexId_logString) (increase(mongot_index_stats_indexing_steadyStateExceptions_total{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"}[1h]) + increase(mongot_index_stats_indexing_initialSyncExceptions_total{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"}[1h]))) * on (indexId_logString) group_left (database, collection, index_name) max by (indexId_logString, database, collection, index_name) (mongodb_search_index_info{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-index-info"} @ end()), "ns", ".", "database", "collection"), "index", " / ", "ns", "index_name") or on (indexId_logString) label_replace(sum by (indexId_logString) (increase(mongot_index_stats_indexing_steadyStateExceptions_total{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"}[1h]) + increase(mongot_index_stats_indexing_initialSyncExceptions_total{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"}[1h])), "index", "$1", "indexId_logString", "(.*)"))

max by (index) (label_join(label_join((max by (indexId_logString) (mongot_index_stats_indexing_replicationLagMs{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"}) / 1000) * on (indexId_logString) group_left (database, collection, index_name) max by (indexId_logString, database, collection, index_name) (mongodb_search_index_info{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-index-info"} @ end()), "ns", ".", "database", "collection"), "index", " / ", "ns", "index_name") or on (indexId_logString) label_replace(max by (indexId_logString) (mongot_index_stats_indexing_replicationLagMs{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"}) / 1000, "index", "$1", "indexId_logString", "(.*)"))

display.name: Size of each index
display.description: Every index mongot holds, biggest first: by its name with the index info exporter on, by its id otherwise. The largest reading over the pods.

spec.query: sort_desc(max by (index) (label_join(label_join((max by (indexId_logString) (mongot_index_stats_indexSizeBytes{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"} @ end())) * on (indexId_logString) group_left (database, collection, index_name) max by (indexId_logString, database, collection, index_name) (mongodb_search_index_info{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-index-info"} @ end()), "ns", ".", "database", "collection"), "index", " / ", "ns", "index_name") or on (indexId_logString) label_replace(max by (indexId_logString) (mongot_index_stats_indexSizeBytes{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"} @ end()), "index", "$1", "indexId_logString", "(.*)")))

display.name: Indexes not STEADY, per index
display.description: For each index, by its name with the index info exporter on and by its id otherwise: whether any pod holds it in a state other than STEADY (INITIAL_SYNC, STALE, FAILED, RECOVERING and the rest). An index that is STALE or RECOVERING still answers searches; one that is INITIAL_SYNC, NOT_STARTED or FAILED does not. The panel of the section above says which pod; this one says which index.

spec.query: max by (index) (label_join(label_join((sum by (indexId_logString) (mongot_index_stats_indexStatusCode{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc",status!="STEADY"})) * on (indexId_logString) group_left (database, collection, index_name) max by (indexId_logString, database, collection, index_name) (mongodb_search_index_info{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-index-info"} @ end()), "ns", ".", "database", "collection"), "index", " / ", "ns", "index_name") or on (indexId_logString) label_replace(sum by (indexId_logString) (mongot_index_stats_indexStatusCode{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc",status!="STEADY"}), "index", "$1", "indexId_logString", "(.*)"))

display.name: Indexes that differ by pod
display.description: Indexes that some pod does not hold, or whose size or document count is not the same on every pod, among the pods that report any index. Should be 0. It is above 0 for up to 3 minutes after an index is built: mongot reads the size of an index from disk every 3 minutes, and a new index reads 0 until then.

spec.query: count((count by (indexId_logString) (max by (indexId_logString, pod) (mongot_index_stats_indexSizeBytes{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"})) != scalar(count(count by (pod) (mongot_index_stats_indexSizeBytes{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"})))) or (max by (indexId_logString) (mongot_index_stats_indexSizeBytes{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"}) != min by (indexId_logString) (mongot_index_stats_indexSizeBytes{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"})) or (max by (indexId_logString) (mongot_index_stats_numLuceneDocs{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"}) != min by (indexId_logString) (mongot_index_stats_numLuceneDocs{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-search-0-svc"}))) or vector(0)

display.name: Size of all indexes, on one pod
display.description: The sizes of all indexes added up, as one pod holds them. Every pod holds every index.

display.name: Search indexes
display.description: Indexes of the type search, counted by index id.

display.name: Vector indexes
display.description: Indexes of a vector type (vectorSearch, and vector search with automatic embedding), counted by index id.

display.name: Memory for vector indexes
display.description: The memory the vector indexes want resident on one pod: for each vector its dimensions (4 bytes each as floats, less when quantized) and 128 bytes of graph. A search index needs none of this. Compare it with the pod's memory.

display.name: Index builds waiting
display.description: Initial syncs queued on the pod that has the most: index builds that have not started because others are running. 0 when none waits.

display.name: Indexes with a name
display.description: Indexes the source deployment names, from the index info exporter (monitoring.indexInfo). It should equal Indexes. 0 when the exporter is off: the panels below then name an index by its id.

spec.query: count(max by (indexId_logString, database, collection, index_name) (mongodb_search_index_info{namespace="__NAMESPACE__",job="__SEARCH__-index-info"} @ end())) or vector(0)

display.name: Indexes with stored source
display.description: Indexes whose definition stores fields (storedSource), from the index info exporter. 0 also when the exporter is off.

display.name: Stored source searches, 1 hour
display.description: $search queries sent with returnStoredSource in the last hour, all pods: mongot answers them from the fields the index stores, with no lookup in the collection. Estimated from a counter, so it can read a fraction off. mongot counts these queries; it does not say which index has stored source or how many bytes it takes.

display.name: Stored source share, searches
display.description: Of the $search queries, the share sent with returnStoredSource, 5 minute rate. 0 when no search ran.

display.name: Stored source vector, 1 hour
display.description: $vectorSearch queries sent with returnStoredSource in the last hour, all pods. Estimated from a counter.

display.name: Stored source share, vector
display.description: Of the $vectorSearch queries, the share sent with returnStoredSource, 5 minute rate. 0 when no vector search ran.

display.name: What stored source adds
display.description: The indexes that store fields, known only with the index info exporter on (monitoring.indexInfo). "Without it" is the smallest index of the same collection and type that stores nothing; "It adds" is the difference. It is a comparison, not a measurement: no metric says what stored source takes, and whatever else differs between the two definitions is in the difference too. The two cells are empty where the collection has no such index.
